notes: Laclede Gas Light Co. coke and by-products plant at the mouth of the River Des Peres: a manufactured-gas/coke plant with tar, benzol, naphthalene, ammonia, and oil storage. Sheet note: fuel coal, coke & gas; water from the Mississippi. The single most significant contamination site in the sample. Houses on E Espenschied / Reilly (top right) are within a block.
